CREATE_GUIDANCE_PATH=
types/rfe/prompts/create-guidance.md

NEXT_ID_FLAGS=--prefix RFE
--dir artifacts/rfe-tasks
INDEX_ENABLED=true
PARENT_FLAG= (empty for rfe)

frontmatter.py schema rfe-task
artifacts/rfe-tasks/RFE-NNN.md
rfe_id ^(RFE-\d+|RHAIRFE-\d+)$
local_id ^RFE-\d+$
type rfe
tracker_ref RHAIRFE-NNNN on submit
title string
priority Blocker|Critical|Major|
Normal|Minor|Undefined
size S|M|L|XL
status Draft|Ready|Submitted|
Archived
parent_key ^(RFE-\d+|RHAIRFE-\d+)$
original_labels list
required: rfe_id, title,
priority, status
